name: dashboard-link-saas
description: SaaS platform for delivering personalized daily dashboards via SMS

scripts.fix:all: pnpm run lint:fix && pnpm run format
scripts.validate: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check
scripts.pmd:setup: curl -L -o pmd-bin.zip https://github.com/pmd/pmd/releases/download/pmd_releases%2F7.7.0/pmd-dist-7.7.0-bin.zip && unzip -q pmd-bin.zip -d . && mv pmd-dist-7.7.0 pmd && rm pmd-bin.zip
scripts.pmd:run: set JAVA_OPTS=-Xmx4g && pmd-bin-7.7.0\bin\pmd.bat cpd --minimum-tokens 50 --format xml --language ecmascript --exclude node_modules --exclude dist --exclude build --no-fail-on-error --dir apps/admin/src --dir apps/api/src --dir apps/worker/src --dir packages/auth/src --dir packages/database/src --dir packages/plugins/src --dir packages/shared/src --dir packages/sms/src --dir packages/tokens/src --dir packages/ui/src > reports/pmd-report.xml
scripts.quality:check: pnpm run copy:paste:detect && pnpm run pmd:run
